rungs.foldTest: 'Російська Федерація was involved in an event' -> 'Росія was involved in an event': same claim, less detail

rejected.reason: Translation and transliteration are not rungs; they represent the same level of specificity in different languages.
A region or continent is not a member of the 'Country' category.

ladder.notes: The ladder identifies the transition from formal state names (containing organizational qualifiers like 'Federation') to common names. Variations in language (e.g., Росія vs Russia) are ignored as rungs per rule 2 and are treated as separate instances of the same level of specificity.
